rule:
S_SPEC provenance re-audit.

Provenance priority, applied in order and recorded per parameter:
  P1 cited external specification (a theoretical value, independent of any run)
  P2 frozen subject manifest / construction parameter
  P3 independently recorded subject metadata
An expected parameter obtainable only by evaluating the implementation is NOT
specification-derived.  Its cell is marked S_SPEC_NOT_GROUNDED and leaves the
S_SPEC arm; it is available for a separately labelled REFERENCE_DERIVED analysis.

Assertions are NOT altered in response to any guard outcome.  The only changes
here are removals of circuit-derived parameters and their replacement by the
independent value where one exists.
